newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HANSA UP, THEN DOWN, AFTER NEW FORECAST.
newsitem.headline: HANSA UP, THEN DOWN, AFTER NEW FORECAST.

text.p: Shares in Hansapank leapt on news of higher 1997 profit forecasts on Tuesday but quickly fell back to previous, lower levels, dealers said.
The share, down before the news amid a lower market, recouped its losses to be unchanged but later slipped back.
By 0815 GMT, its spread was 188/190 kroons versus a close on Monday of 192.50 kroons. In Helsinki, where it is also traded, the stock was at 70.50 markka compared with 71 markka.
"It was good estimate, but it was an expected figure with nothing surprising about it," one trader said.
"It has not really affected the price, there was a quick rise but it has come back to its normal level," he added.
The bank raised its 1997 forecast to 380 million kroons from 256 million kroons for its bank activities and to 475 million kroons from 320 million kroons for the group.
